name: Shadow's Claw can be activated from the material deck with four or more preparation counters
notes: Clicking Shadow's Claw in the material deck during the main phase puts it onto the field when the champion holds four preparation counters. The counters are a condition, not a cost: all four stay on the champion.

rulesClauses: As long as you have four or more preparation counters on your champion, you may activate this card from your material deck.
